defense_news.title: Estonia’s KrattWorks crafting Shahed-like dummy drone for target practice
defense_news.summary: The Estonian company, which has announced a Shahed-like target drone, will show its products at this year's AUSA conference in Washington.

defense_news.title: Century-old houses getting new life at Fort Bragg
defense_news.summary: 230 homes built before 1940 are being renovated at Fort Bragg.

defense_news.title: Pentagon barred Qatar base access to hide Iran war damage, US senator claims
defense_news.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, during a recent Congressional Delegation trip in what he calls a "cover-up."

defense_news.title: Sig Sauer develops 25-round mag for Army’s next-gen rifle
defense_news.summary: Soldier feedback, from the constructive to the blistering, has been instrumental in guiding Sig Sauer in its development of the M8 carbine.
